title: SuperDew Shimmer-Free Highlight Balm

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, oilFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Vegan

What it is: A clear highlight balm with no shimmer or glitter for that glassy, luminous skin-effect without pore-clogging ingredients and is safe for sensitive skin.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, and Uneven Texture


Formulation: Lightweight Cream


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Green Tea Extract: Calms redness and irritation.

- Aloe Vera Extract: Hydrating and soothing for a dewy-skin finish.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, cruelty-free, and gluten-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use your fingers to warm up the product in the pan.
-Tap onto the high points of your face: cheeks, brow-bone, and nose bridge (anywhere the sun shines!).
-For glossy eye looks, tap (don't blend!) SuperDew onto eyelids.
Ingredients+
-Green Tea Extract: Calms redness and irritation.
-Aloe Vera Extract: Hydrating and soothing for a dewy-skin finish.

Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Diisostearyl Malate, Triisostearyl Citrate, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina), Jojoba Esters, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Orbignya Oleifera Seed Oil, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Chamomilla Recutita (Matricaria) Flower Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Extract, Carthamus Tinctorius (Safflower) Seed Oil, Acacia Decurrens Flower Wax, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Tocopherol, Polyglycerin-3, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, May contain: Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891).



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
